method: Landmark exceptions (user decision 2026-09-24): a few structures the general rules cannot represent get an authored builder. An entry is keyed by the footprint id (a join key) and owns that footprint completely; the general heuristic never reads this file for its own rules. Builders still take their shape from measurements (LiDAR surface, return intensity, mapped outlines); authored parts are named in each entry's props.
